query:
UPDATE "Node"
           SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'MAINTENANCE'::"NodeStatus"
                             THEN status ELSE $2::text::"NodeStatus" END,
               "cpuUsage" = $3, "memUsage" = $4,
               "lastCheckAt" = $5, "lastPingMs" = NULL, "updatedAt" = $5
           WHERE id = $1
